newsitem.title: UK: Telewest calls off Channel 5 talks- paper.
newsitem.headline: Telewest calls off Channel 5 talks- paper.

text.p: UK cable operator Telewest Plc has called off talks with Channel 5, the UK's new terrestrial television station, aimed at agreeing terms to retune millions of video recorders around Telewest's franchise areas, the Independent newspaper reported on Tuesday.
The 100 million stg-plus retuning drive at 9.6 million homes is necessary to prepare receiving equipment for the new Channel 5 signal, which could cause interference.

But the Independent said month-long talks between Channel 5 Broadcasting and Telewest had foundered over the price the cable company wanted per household for the job and the schedule of the retuning operation.
A Telewest insider was quoted scorning Channel 5's terms as "just ridiculous." "We felt the same about them," a Channel 5 spokeswoman was quoted as retorting.
The companies were not immediately available for comment.
